title: 第17章 大佬来电第18章 搭档
lines: 半个小时后，门口响起一阵脚步声，只见柳寞面无表情的出现在众人的视线中，在他身后，亦步亦趋的跟着一名中年男子，正是齐斌。几天没有现身，齐斌除了脸色稍显苍白，并没有其他变化。
看到齐斌出现在门口，谭平顿时吃了一惊，难以置信的看着对方，好半天说不出话来。
“你就是齐斌？”柳初晴打量着来人，问道。
“是我。”齐斌面带笑容，满含歉意道：“警官，实在不好意思，这几天刚好有事外出，没想到会闹出这么大的误会。江先生，抱歉，给你添麻烦了。”
听到这话，柳初晴看着谭平道：“你之前报案说，亲眼看到齐斌被他杀了，这到底怎么回事？”
“这……我……”谭平看了看齐斌，又看了看江来，一时愣在原地，不知道该怎么解释。见状，柳初晴轻哼一身，不悦道：“徐青，你都没调查清楚，就冒冒失失的带人前来问罪，难怪人家会拒捕。要不是我及时赶到，估计又是一件屈打成招的冤案。这件事情我会汇报局长，你就等着受处分吧。”
徐青面色微变，眼中的怒火越来越旺盛，真恨不得当场收拾这贱女人。可是，一想到对方的强硬后台，他立刻软了下去。
“来人，把这混蛋给我抓回去，居然敢戏弄我们，看我怎么收拾他。”徐青大声的咆哮道，把怒火全都发泄到了谭平身上，后者打了个寒颤，急忙道：“徐警官，我……我是无辜的，我……”
话还未说完，他已经被几名便衣强行拖出了房间。
看着徐青一行人离去，齐斌挤出一丝笑容道：“警官，要是没别的事情，那我先走了。”
柳初晴扫了眼旁边的柳寞，对方从进来到现在始终一言不发，神情冷峻，而且，那人给她的感觉很不舒服，犹如一头危险的野兽，随时可能咬破她的喉咙。
“行了，你走吧。”沉吟了片刻，她挥挥手，示意他可以走了。
坐在沙发上的江来微微扬唇，不愧是四大天王之一，柳寞做事从没让他失望过。齐斌能这么配合，全是他的功劳。
“柳警官，其他人都走了，你还留在这干什么，难不成想让我请你吃晚饭？”
柳初晴没好气的白了他一眼，道：“江先生，实不相瞒，刚刚插手徐青的案子只是巧合，我今天来的主要目的是找你，没想到会碰到他们。”
“找我？”江来弹了弹手中的烟灰，饶有兴趣的看着柳初晴，问道：“柳警官，我跟你素不相识，你找我干什么？”
“我只是受人之托。”话落，柳初晴从随身携带的公文包中拿出一台平板电脑，摆放在茶几上，然后转身走入隔壁的卧室。
看到她的举动，江来眯了眯眼，深邃的瞳仁中精光闪烁。恰在这时，那台平板电脑的屏幕突然亮了起来，是一个视频通话请求，他犹豫了一下，轻轻按下接听键。
顿时，视频书面中出现了一张苍老的面孔，那是一个头发花白的老头，虽然面庞有些清癯，但精神矍铄，带着一股不怒自威的气势。不过，最为惹眼的还是他身上笔挺的军装，和肩章上三颗闪亮的将星。
三星上将！
在华国的军队中，职衔最高的便是三星上将，一军统帅。
“小子，又见面了。”老头笑眯眯的看着江来，似乎对他很熟悉，说起话来并没有太多客套。
江来撇了撇嘴，“我道是谁，弄得这么神秘，原来是你这老头。”
“你小子跑到我的地盘来了，也不跟我打个招呼，怎么？怕我吃了你不成。”
“切！那你也得有这本事。”
“你知不知道，因为你的突然出现，害得军区的几位大佬茶饭不思，整天提心吊胆，生怕你闯出什么祸来，几个王牌特种部队都已经暗中调派到QZ市附近，你一天不走，大家都不得安宁。”
江来哭笑不得道：“放心吧，我这次只是来华国散散心，处理一些私事，你们用不着弄那么大的阵仗。再说了，如果我真想搞破坏，你们谁都别想发现我的行踪。”
“话虽如此，不过，当年你的老师，圣殿的上任国王在华国大闹一番，造成无数死伤，这让我们不得不防。”
“老头子，以你的身份和能耐，不可能不知道圣殿的变故，你觉得我现在还有能力大举进犯吗？行了！咱们都别扯这些没用的，以我对你这头老狐狸的了解，如果你们真想赶我离开华国，绝不会这么多废话。”

“你小子果然是个明白人，既然如此，那我就不藏着掖着了。当年你向我承诺，只要你在位一天，就不会入侵华国。可是，现在局势发生变化，我们不得不重新做出考虑。实不相瞒，安德鲁接管圣殿后，我们尝试过跟他联系，想要继续履行你我的约定，但安德鲁并没有给我们明确的答复，一直借口推脱。我调查过他，这个人野心勃勃，做事不择手段，是个极度危险的人物。而且，他已经秘密派人在华国的周边国家进行渗透。我担心的是，一旦他整合完四大洲的地下势力，很可能会将手伸向华国。”
“所以呢？”
“你是圣殿的上任国王，没人比你更了解圣殿的实力，我们几个老头子商量了下，可以在华国为你提供庇护，但你必须协助我们防备圣殿。如有必要，可能需要你亲自出手。”
江来沉思了一会，缓缓点头道：“这个提议我可以接受。”
“小子，虽然我们准许你留在华国，但你最好安分一点，别到处惹是生非，不然我们不好交代。另外，小晴是军方的人，她会负责看着你。还有，她并不清楚你的真实身份，所以你最好别说漏了嘴。”
江来失笑道：“老头子，你安插一个美女在我身边，难不成是想对我用美人计？”
“只要你有本事俘获她的芳心，我老头子不会多管闲事。对了！小晴在QZ市身负秘密任务，如果可以的话，希望你能给她一点帮助，毕竟你是这方面的专家。”
“这方面？”江来一怔，不明所以。
content_en:
Half an hour later, there was a sound of footsteps at the door, and Liu Mo appeared in everyone's sight with an expressionless face. Behind him, a middle-aged man followed step by step, it was Qi Bin. After not showing up for a few days, Qi Bin had no other changes except that his face was slightly pale.
Tan Ping was startled when he saw Qi Bin appearing at the door. He looked at him in disbelief and was speechless for a long time.
"Are you Qi Bin?" Liu Chuqing looked at the visitor and asked.
"It's me." Qi Bin said apologetically with a smile on his face: "Officer, I'm really sorry. I happened to be out on business these days. I didn't expect such a big misunderstanding. Mr. Jiang, I'm sorry for causing you trouble."
Hearing this, Liu Chuqing looked at Tan Ping and said, "You reported to the police before that you saw Qi Bin being killed by him. What on earth is going on?"
"This...I..." Tan Ping looked at Qi Bin and then at Jiang Lai. He was stunned for a moment, not knowing how to explain. Seeing this, Liu Chuqing snorted and said displeasedly: "Xu Qing, you didn't investigate clearly, so you rashly brought people here to question the crime. No wonder they resisted arrest. If I hadn't arrived in time, it would probably have been another unjust case that was forced into submission. I will report this matter to the director, and you just wait to be punished."
Xu Qing's complexion changed slightly, and the anger in his eyes became more and more intense. He really wanted to deal with this bitch on the spot. However, when he thought of the opponent's tough background, he immediately softened.
"Come here, take this bastard back to me. He dares to tease us. Let's see how I deal with him." Xu Qing roared loudly, venting all his anger on Tan Ping. The latter shuddered and said hurriedly: "Officer Xu, I... I am innocent, I..."
Before he could finish speaking, he was forcibly dragged out of the room by several plainclothes men.
Watching Xu Qing and his party leave, Qi Bin forced out a smile and said, "Officer, if there is nothing else, I'll leave first."
Liu Chuqing glanced at Liu Mo next to her. He had not said a word since he came in, and his expression was cold. Moreover, the man made her feel very uncomfortable, like a dangerous beast that might bite her throat at any time.
"Okay, you can go." After pondering for a moment, she waved her hand to indicate that he could leave.
Jiang Lai, who was sitting on the sofa, raised his lips slightly. He was worthy of being one of the Four Heavenly Kings. Liu Mo had never let him down in his work. Qi Bin's cooperation is all due to him.
"Officer Liu, everyone else has left. Why are you still here? Do you want me to treat you to dinner?"
Liu Chuqing rolled her eyes at him angrily and said, "Mr. Jiang, to be honest, it was just a coincidence that I just intervened in Xu Qing's case. My main purpose of coming today was to find you. I didn't expect to run into them."
"Looking for me?" Jiang Lai flicked the cigarette ashes in his hand, looked at Liu Chuqing with interest, and asked: "Officer Liu, I have never met you, why are you looking for me?"
"I was just entrusted by someone." After saying this, Liu Chuqing took out a tablet computer from the briefcase he carried with him, placed it on the coffee table, then turned and walked into the bedroom next door.
Seeing her actions, Jiang Lai squinted his eyes, his deep pupils shining with light. Just at this moment, the screen of the tablet computer suddenly lit up. It was a video call request. He hesitated and gently pressed the answer button.
Suddenly, an old face appeared in the video. It was an old man with gray hair. Although his face was a little pale, he was energetic and had an aura of calmness and self-respect. However, the most eye-catching thing is the straight military uniform on his body and the three shining general stars on the epaulettes.
Three-star general!
In the Chinese army, the highest-ranking person is the three-star general, the commander-in-chief of the first army.
"Boy, we meet again." The old man looked at Jiang Lai with a smile, as if he was very familiar with him, and he didn't speak too politely.
Jiang Lai curled his lips and said, "I wonder who it is that makes it so mysterious. It turns out to be you, old man."
"You came to my territory and didn't say hello to me. What's wrong? You were afraid that I would eat you."
"Tch! Then you must have this ability."
"Do you know that because of your sudden appearance, several big guys in the military region have no time to think about food and drink. They are worried all day long, for fear that you will cause some trouble. Several ace special forces have been secretly deployed near QZ City. If you don't leave for a day, everyone will not be safe."
Jiang Lai couldn't laugh or cry and said: "Don't worry, I just came to China this time to relax and deal with some personal matters. You don't need to make such a big fuss. Besides, if I really want to cause damage, none of you can even think of discovering my whereabouts."
"Having said that, your teacher and the previous king of the temple made a big fuss in China, causing countless casualties, which forced us to take precautions."
"Old man, with your status and ability, it is impossible that you are unaware of the changes in the temple. Do you think I am still capable of a large-scale invasion now? Okay! Let's not talk about these useless things. Based on my understanding of you, an old fox, if you really want to drive me away from China, you will never talk so much nonsense."
"You are indeed a sensible man. If so, I won't hide it anymore. Back then, you promised me that you would not invade China as long as you were in power for one day. However, now that the situation has changed, we have to reconsider. To be honest, after Andrew took over the temple, we tried to contact him and wanted to continue to fulfill our agreement between you and me. , but Andrew did not give us a clear answer and kept making excuses. I have investigated him and found that this person is ambitious and unscrupulous and is an extremely dangerous person. Moreover, he has secretly sent people to infiltrate the surrounding countries of China. What I am worried about is that once he completes the integration of underground forces in the four continents, he is likely to reach out to China.
"So?"
"You are the previous king of the Temple. No one knows the strength of the Temple better than you. We old men have discussed that we can provide you with shelter in China, but you must help us defend the Temple. If necessary, you may need to take action yourself."
Jiang Lai thought for a while, nodded slowly and said, "I can accept this proposal."
"Boy, although we allow you to stay in China, you'd better be calm and don't cause trouble everywhere, otherwise it will be difficult for us to explain. In addition, Xiaoqing is from the military, and she will be responsible for watching over you. Also, she doesn't know your true identity, so you'd better not let it slip."
Jiang Laishi smiled and said: "Old man, you placed a beautiful woman next to me. Could it be that you want to use a beauty trap on me?"
"As long as you have the ability to capture her heart, my old man will not meddle in her own business. By the way! Xiaoqing has a secret mission in QZ City. If possible, I hope you can give her some help. After all, you are an expert in this field."
"In this regard?" Jiang Lai was startled and didn't know why.
